tasks.short: Discuss financial options and recent transactions.

steps.what: List financial options already held for this client.
Discuss those financial options and recent transactions.
Sign the note of what the client was told.

tasks.design: A {CRM} view lists the financial options already on the book and the recent transactions. The agent discusses them with the client. The note of what was said is signed and stored in {DOCS}. It is a record of the talk, not a new recommendation.
tasks.previous_blocker: The holdings and the last transactions were on different screens, so the talk started from memory.
tasks.enabler_now: Holdings are already records. Putting them on one view does not require a model to choose a product.
tasks.still_hard: What to say about a loss, and whether the client understood, is still the conversation.
tasks.human_edge: The agent judges what this client should hear. A list of options is not that judgement.
tasks.altitude: The talk stays with the agent. The change is that the holdings are on the screen and the note is signed.

reach.task: talk a client through the cover already in force
reach.learn: which sentence is a record of the talk and which is new advice

evidence.claim: Showing holdings and recent transactions is a dashboard. The discussion stays with the agent.

The job digest says securities advice stays with the person, and advising staff need a diploma. A draft is not the advice. The job digest says call recording and scoring of sellers need works-council consent. This task adds neither.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: The task is the discussion of options already held. A new plan or a new order is another task.

Fields: client id, instrument id, quantity, last transaction date, product name. Holdings come from the {CRM}. The note text is written by the agent. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the agent finishes it by hand.
Native check: The {CRM} already stores holdings. The build is a view and a signed note, not a new product picker.
No call recording and no seller score are added. Any edit to the note voids the signature.
unknowns: Whether the note is required for professional clients as well as retail.
Whether holdings are complete in the {CRM}.
research_questions: What share of these talks has no written note today?
How often is a holding missing from the screen?

already_counted.description: The agent still holds the discussion.
The agent still signs the note.

incremental.description: Keep the holdings view mapped to the product list.

approvals.approved_version: options-note v1: client-id, instrument-ids, note-text, talk-date

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the talk is still a long call and the holdings feed is incomplete, the agent still prepares from memory and the note is the only reliable saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List instruments the house can purchase or sell.
Identify purchase opportunities the client has not used.
Develop a channel note for the securities desk.

tasks.design: The {CRM} lists instruments the house can purchase or sell. The agent identifies opportunities the client has not used and writes a channel note for the securities or commodities desk. Nothing is sent to a client from this note. A recommendation waits for a separate advice task.
tasks.previous_blocker: The product list and the client's holdings were not on one screen, so gaps were spotted only for large clients.
tasks.enabler_now: A gap between the house list and the holdings is a comparison. Choosing which gap matters is still judgement.
tasks.still_hard: A channel that looks open may be wrong for this client, and the agent is accountable for that.
tasks.human_edge: The agent decides which unused instrument is a real opportunity. A gap on a screen is not that decision.

ambition.what: Look for an unused instrument on smaller books as well, and write the channel note the same week.

tasks.altitude: The agent still chooses the opportunity. Finding the gap on a screen replaces hunting through two lists.

reach.task: see which site has no assessment yet
reach.learn: which gap is only a missing record and which one a person must judge

evidence.claim: Comparing a product list with holdings is a dashboard. The job digest leaves the judgement of an opportunity with the person.
The job digest says securities advice stays with the person, and advising staff need a diploma. A draft is not the advice.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: The task ends at the internal channel note. It does not send advice and does not place an order.

Fields: instrument id, asset class, client id, held quantity. The house list is maintained by the desk. Held quantity comes from the {CRM}. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the agent finishes it by hand.
Native check: The {CRM} already has products and holdings. The build is a comparison view, not a new research terminal.
The channel note is internal. It is not a client communication and carries no seller score.
unknowns: Who owns the house product list.
Whether commodities sit in the same list as securities.
research_questions: What share of clients is never checked for a gap?
How often is a listed instrument not actually offered?

already_counted.description: The agent still chooses the opportunities.
The agent still writes the channel note.

incremental.description: Keep the house instrument list current.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the house list is stale, the agent still rebuilds it by hand and the comparison saves little until the list is trusted.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Develop a financial plan from client status.

steps.what: Assemble the client's financial status fields.
Draft a plan that cites only those status fields.

loop.input: Status fields and the house product list.
loop.output: A plan whose every number cites a status field.
loop.check: Reject any number that is not equal to a status field, and any product not on the list.
loop.stop: If more than three figures fail, stop and leave the status sheet for the agent.
loop.why_not_simpler: A blank template cannot tell which liability the client meant, but each figure must still trace.

steps.what: Decide the financial plan and sign it.

tasks.design: Status fields sit in the {CRM}: income, assets, liabilities, horizon and constraints. A draft plan may cite only those fields, and every figure is checked against them. The agent signs the plan in {DOCS}. The draft is not the advice, and an unsigned plan is not sent.
tasks.previous_blocker: Plans were written from memory of the interview, so a figure could not be traced to a field.
tasks.enabler_now: A plan figure can be required to equal a stored status field. The decision to recommend still cannot.
tasks.still_hard: Suitability for this client is a judgement, and a missing status field makes the draft useless.
tasks.human_edge: The agent signs the plan and owns the recommendation. The draft only arranges fields the client already gave.

ambition.what: Sign a traced plan for smaller clients as well, not only for the accounts large enough to rewrite by hand.

tasks.altitude: The agent still signs every plan. Hunting for the last interview's numbers leaves the week.

reach.task: draft a cover proposal from a completed fact-find
reach.learn: which numbers must equal the fact-find before a signature

evidence.claim: The job digest says a model may draft and the adviser signs, and that financial plans stay with the person. Figures must trace to status fields.
The job digest says securities advice stays with the person, and advising staff need a diploma. A draft is not the advice.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: The task starts from a confirmed interview and ends at a signed plan. Placing the orders in the plan is another task.

Fields: income, assets, liabilities, horizon, constraint text, product id. Status comes from the confirmed interview. A product not on the house list cannot appear. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the agent finishes it by hand.
Native check: The {CRM} already holds the interview. The build drafts from those fields and blocks a number that does not match.
The signature is the advice. Any edit voids it. No automated suitability score is stored.
unknowns: Whether the firm's advice policy allows a draft at all.
Which status fields are mandatory before a plan.
research_questions: What share of plans has a figure that cannot be traced today?
How often does the agent reject the draft outright?

already_counted.description: The agent still reviews the draft.
The agent still decides and signs the plan.

incremental.description: Keep the trace rule and the product list current.

approvals.approved_version: plan v1: client-id, status-fields, product-ids, plan-date

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If status fields are often empty, the draft stops and the agent writes the plan as today, so the saving is only the cases with a complete fact-find.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Match each securities transaction to the order.
Flag a break in accuracy or a missed rule.

tasks.design: Each securities transaction is matched in {BI} to the order, the account and a written rule list. Breaks in accuracy are flagged. The agent reviews the flagged rows and signs the day in {DOCS}. Clean rows are not retyped and are not a judgement.
tasks.previous_blocker: The whole blotter was read by eye, so a quiet error waited until a complaint.
tasks.enabler_now: A match on instrument, size, price and account is a rule. The cause of a break is not.
tasks.still_hard: A rule list that is wrong will flag the wrong rows, and a regulatory reading of a grey case stays with the agent.
tasks.human_edge: The agent decides whether a break is a late fill, a bad account, or a rule the firm must report.

ambition.what: Review the flagged transactions every day, including books too small to read line by line.

tasks.altitude: The agent stops rereading clean rows and still signs the exceptions.

reach.task: check a completed sale against the written offer and the fee rule
reach.learn: which mismatch is arithmetic and which one a person must sign

evidence.claim: The job digest treats transaction checks as code and dashboards. The sign-off on a break stays with the person.
The job digest says order-related calls and messages are kept for five years, and up to seven, even when no trade follows. This stores that message. It does not score the agent.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: The task is the review of transactions already booked. It does not place a new order.

Fields: transaction id, order id, instrument, side, size, price, account, rule id. Rows come from the blotter and the order ticket. A row with no order id is flagged. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the agent finishes it by hand.
Native check: The blotter and the rule list already exist. The build matches them. It does not add a second ledger.
Only flagged rows need the signature. Any change to a corrected row voids that signature. No seller score is added.
unknowns: Which rule set is the governing one for this desk.
Whether the firm must file a break the same day.
research_questions: What share of rows is clean on a normal day?
How often is a flag a late fill rather than an error?

already_counted.description: The agent still reviews and signs the flagged rows.

incremental.description: Keep the match rules and the rule list current.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the rule list is noisy and most flags are late fills, the agent still opens nearly every row and the match saves only the sort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The agent keeps the options talk, the channel judgement and the plan signature. Listing holdings and matching transactions leave the hour.
reach: Insurance sales agent: discuss a renewal from the cover already on the file, and learn which change is a new piece of advice.
Real estate broker: review a completed sale against the written offer, and learn which mismatch must be signed off.
skills_to_grow: Separate a note of what was said from a new recommendation.
Read a transaction break as a rule miss or as a late fill.
role.ambitious_version: A financial plan is signed from status fields for smaller clients as well, and a transaction break is looked at the same day.
